findings.finding: BW has an open ATM with about $62.5m of room (the $200m 2025 Sales Agreement, $137.5m sold by 2026-05-12) and resale registrations for about 11.7m selling-stockholder shares and about 25.6m BRC Group shares. This is supply that can sell into any bounce during the 2026-09-25 session. It is only partly offset by the $50m buyback authorised on 2026-07-13.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM and registered resales can sell on any session, 2026-09-25 included, with no further filing. The issuer has drawn this program repeatedly (Jan-Jun 2026, per the 10-Q). It lands in the window only as flow, not as an announcement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-11-07 ATM disclosure drew a -5.6% day (Investing.com). The May 2026 $200m follow-on and later dilution pressure preceded the -33% slide from 06-26 to 07-24 (Tickeron). No dated in-window draw is visible, so the history sizes the overhang and not a scheduled event.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang has been public since May, so most of it is in the price. What the price may not hold is that the program's room is still there at a far lower share price, so any 09-25 bounce meets issuer and holder supply. If the market had fully priced it, the name's recent comparable falls would show no drag. Instead 8 of the last 12 had a negative next close.
